messages.subject: Error while performing normalization
parts:
Hi Kylie,

I am using Cardinal to work with a MSI dataset available on the PRIDE database (PXD001283). This dataset is in preprocessed *.imzML format. So, first I converted it to continuous format using the SpectralAnalysis tool (https://github.com/AlanRace/SpectralAnalysis).  

I am able to work with this dataset without applying any prepossessing steps. However, while trying to perform normalization, I get this error:

> normalize(HRData_C_CAR, pixel = 1, method = "tic", plot = TRUE)
normalize: Using method = tic
Error in if (auc > 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Smoothing the data works. But then, on trying to perform baseline correction, I get the following error:

> reduceBaseline(HRData_C_CAR, pixel=1, method="median", blocks=50, plot=TRUE)
reduceBaseline: Using method = median
Error in baseidx + c(0, cumsum(sapply(xint, length))[-length(xint)]) : 
  non-numeric argument to binary operator

I am not sure whats causing these errors. But I assume it to be related to some format issues with the converted continuous *.imzML file.
Can you maybe give some hint?

Many thanks,
Purva

messages.author: 1501960bb9b3de0f
messages.subject: Re: Error while performing normalization
parts: With the processed *.imzML format the normalization works (I just checked).

Glad things worked out for you.

-Kylie
